question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the highlighted word.

The government’s **utilitarian** stance was appreciated by all.
solution:
The solution is functional.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the highlighted word in "The government’s **utilitarian** stance was appreciated by all." is functional.
 
• **Utilitarian **means designed to be useful or practical rather than attractive. (उपयोगी )
 
• Example: A utilitarian building.
 
• **Functional**: Having a special activity, purpose, or task. (कार्यात्मक)
 
• Example: A functional role.
 
• Therefore option 1 is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• Let's discuss information about other options:
 
 
• **Fanciful - **Over-imaginative and unrealistic. (कल्पनाशील)
 
• **Distasteful - **Causing dislike or aversion; disagreeable or unpleasant. (अप्रिय)
 
• **Necessary - **Needed to be done, achieved, or present or essential. (आवश्यक )
